effects.description: (2 items) Adds 3-129 Weapon and Spell Damage

(5 items) When you use a Light Attack you reduce the Health, Magicka, or Stamina cost of your next active ability cast within |cffffff2|r seconds by |cffffff10|r%.  

When you use a fully-charged Heavy Attack you gain Empower for |cffffff3|r seconds, increasing the damage of your Heavy Attacks against monsters by |cffffff150|r%.

Each of these effects can occur once every second.
